reason_detail: Phase 2 in COPD: no improvement; authors call for dose-finding studies. Did not improve sweat chloride, mucociliary clearance, lung function or symptoms over 12 weeks (n=40); drug exposure was lower than in cystic fibrosis.
side_effects: Most common adverse event on ivacaftor: diarrhea; adverse event rates similar to placebo.

reason_detail: Phase 2b: primary endpoint negative; later development: not stated in sources. No dose-response for trough FEV1 at week 12 (primary endpoint); some improvements at week 24 that the authors say must be interpreted with caution.

Phase 3 RESOLUTE (2025) missed its primary endpoint; AstraZeneca to analyse the full data. RESOLUTE (n=689, eosinophils >=300/uL, 3 or more exacerbations in the prior year): numerical improvement but no statistically significant reduction in exacerbations.
side_effects: Safety and tolerability consistent with the known profile.

reason_detail: Phase 3 ARNASA missed primary endpoint (phase 2b ALIENTO met it); Roche to discuss next steps with regulators. ARNASA (n=1,375): 14.5% numerical reduction in annualized exacerbations, not significant; ALIENTO (n=1,301): 15.4%, significant. Exacerbations lower than anticipated in both.

Early study: target engaged but no anti-inflammatory effect; authors conclude PI3K delta is not a suitable COPD pathway. 29.7% reduction in sputum PIP3 (target engagement) did not translate into any anti-inflammatory pharmacodynamic effect.
side_effects: Cough in 95.2% of patients, mostly mild to moderate, resolving within an hour of dosing.

reason_detail: Phase 3 mixed: AERIFY-1 met primary endpoint, AERIFY-2 did not; companies to discuss path forward with regulators. AERIFY-2 exacerbation reduction at week 52: 2% (every 2 weeks) and 12% (every 4 weeks), not significant; AERIFY-1: 27% and 21%, significant. Fewer exacerbations than anticipated reduced power.
side_effects: Adverse events comparable to placebo (AERIFY-1: 67% and 68% vs 68%; AERIFY-2: 64% and 71% vs 64%).
